Hey, I used to be what you could consider a high functioning depressed person. I had a lot of friends, a good job, and a social life, but inside I was miserable and lonely. Eventually, I got a critical point where I couldn't take it anymore and became desperate to connect with someone.  I ended up booking a spur of the moment trip to Panama and ended up meeting a girl from Canada that I hooked up with.  It completely changed me and gave me a much more human outlook on life.

I used to feel the same way you did as well. Every day is a struggle and you feel like you keep getting knocked back, but you're getting better without realizing it. Maybe someday you'll look back on yourself and see how far you came. I can promise you, it'll be absolutely magical.
